# Boutique Japan

> > Boutique Japan is a luxury Japan travel company offering curated itineraries, expert guides, and insider knowledge for exploring Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and beyond.

Boutique Japan specializes in bespoke travel experiences across Japan, featuring expert insights from contributors like Yukari Sakamoto and John Gauntner. The site provides comprehensive guides to Japanese cuisine, regional destinations, cultural experiences, and practical travel logistics including shinkansen travel and luggage forwarding services.

## Key Topics

- Tokyo
- Kyoto
- Osaka
- Japanese cuisine
- Luxury travel
- Shinkansen
- Regional destinations (Hokkaido, Kyushu, Fukuoka, Okinawa)
- Ryokans and traditional accommodations
- Japanese whisky and sake
- Art destinations (Naoshima)
- UNESCO heritage sites
- Travel logistics and etiquette
- Expert travel insights
- Off-the-beaten-path Japan
- Food culture and regional specialties

## Essential Travel Planning

- [Japan Travel FAQ: Planning Your Trip](https://boutiquejapan.com/questions): Common Japan travel questions: destinations, ryokans, food, etiquette
- [Japan Itinerary: 8 Days to Explore Tokyo, Kyoto & Hakone](https://boutiquejapan.com/japan-essentials-tokyo-kyoto-and-hakone-8-days): 8-day luxury itinerary: Tokyo, Kyoto, Hakone near Mount Fuji
- [Expert Tips for Your Japan Packing List](https://boutiquejapan.com/japan-travel-tips-packing-for-japan): Japan packing tips: what to bring, luggage forwarding, travel essentials
- [Luggage Shipping in Japan: the Magic of Takuhaibin](https://boutiquejapan.com/luggage-forwarding): Guide to takuhaibin luggage forwarding service for train travelers

## Regional Destination Guides

- [A Guide to Visiting Osaka, Japan](https://boutiquejapan.com/places-we-love-osaka): Comprehensive Osaka travel guide: food, nightlife, and transportation
- [Unique Off-The-Beaten-Path Japan Destinations](https://boutiquejapan.com/5-best-off-the-beaten-path-places-in-japan): Alternative destinations: Kyushu, Tohoku, Shikoku, Hokkaido, Okinawa
- [The Best Day Hikes Around Tokyo: Kamakura & More](https://boutiquejapan.com/best-hikes-near-tokyo): Guide to 4 day hikes near Tokyo including Mt. Takao and Kamakura trails
- [Shirakawago & Gokayama: UNESCO World Heritage Villages](https://boutiquejapan.com/shirakawago-gokayama): UNESCO villages guide: Shirakawago & Gokayama gassho-zukuri houses

## Japanese Cuisine & Food Culture

- [Kyoto Cuisine: Foods to Eat in the Ancient Capital](https://boutiquejapan.com/kyoto-food): Essential Kyoto foods including kaiseki and seasonal specialties
- [Fukuoka (aka Hakata): One of Japan's Best Food Cities](https://boutiquejapan.com/food-in-fukuoka): Fukuoka food guide featuring Hakata ramen and regional specialties
- [A Guide to Ekiben: Eating & Drinking on Japan's Trains](https://boutiquejapan.com/ekiben): Guide to ekiben bento boxes and dining on shinkansen trains
- [Okinawa Food: 10 Unique Culinary Experiences to Explore](https://boutiquejapan.com/okinawa-food): Okinawan cuisine guide: chanpuru dishes and Ryukyu Islands specialties

## Japanese Beverages & Spirits

- [Japanese Whisky: A Guide to Japan's Best Distilleries](https://boutiquejapan.com/japanese-whisky-distilleries): Guide to 6 iconic distilleries including Suntory Yamazaki near Kyoto
- [Shochu 101: An Introduction To Shochu](https://boutiquejapan.com/shochu): Introduction to shochu, Japan's popular distilled spirit vs sake
- [Where to Drink Tea in Japan](https://boutiquejapan.com/tea-in-japan): Japanese tea guide: matcha, sencha varieties and where to drink in Japan

## Art & Culture

- [Japan's Best Art Destinations & Triennales](https://boutiquejapan.com/japans-best-art-destinations): Art islands, museums, and triennales across Tokyo, Kyoto, and beyond
- [Japan & Travel Experts Share their Favorite Spots in Japan](https://boutiquejapan.com/experts-share-favorite-places-in-japan): Experts like Pico Iyer & Yukari Sakamoto share favorite Japan destinations

## Travel Updates & Support
